title: Drop of Success
description: Semester 01 — Drop of Success: personal growth explored through Platonic solids.
lead: Drop of Success explores personal growth through Platonic solids. Three forms represent myself, the people who support my journey, and the strength I aspire to achieve.
summary: Personal growth explored through Platonic solids. Three forms stand for myself, the people who support my journey, and the strength I aspire to achieve.
cv_line: Conceptual study and physical model using Platonic solids

head.title: Concept
head.sub: From Platonic solids to a personal journey
head.intro: The project began by exploring Platonic solids and their symbolic relationship to natural elements. Three forms were selected and given personal meanings to develop the concept “A Journey”.

blocks.label: Exploring Platonic solids
blocks.alt: Tetrahedron, cube, octahedron, dodecahedron and icosahedron

items.text: Represents my adaptability and growth throughout the journey.
Represents the people who support and guide me.
Represents the strength and confidence I aspire to achieve.

head.title: Design
head.intro: “A Journey” represents my personal growth. The icosahedron represents myself and adaptability, the cubes represent the people who support me, and the tetrahedron represents the strength I aspire to achieve. Together, the forms express my journey towards growth and confidence.

items.title: Starting point
items.text: The journey begins with the icosahedron, representing myself.

items.title: Support
items.text: Cubes are introduced to represent support throughout the journey.

items.title: Growth
items.text: The form develops upward, expressing growth towards the goal.

items.title: Final composition
items.text: The tetrahedron completes the journey, representing strength.

figure.alt: Annotated physical model: icosahedron, cubes and tetrahedron

paragraphs: The central icosahedron is the adaptable self. Cubes rise around it along the curved frame as the people who support and guide, and the tetrahedron crowns the composition as the strength aspired to.
blocks.statement: The final composition expresses a journey from adaptability and support towards strength and growth.
